class TwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        old_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        old_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma

        self.sma.Update(data.Bars[self.spy].EndTime, spy_close)
        self.rsi.Update(data.Bars[self.aapl].EndTime, aapl_close)

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        current_spy_sma = self.sma.Current.Value if self.sma.IsReady else None
        current_rsi = self.rsi.Current.Value if self.rsi.IsReady else None

        if self.spy_lot > 0:
            if (
                old_spy_close is not None
                and old_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and old_spy_close >= old_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_spy_sma
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
                self.spy_lot = 0
        else:
            if (
                old_spy_close is not None
                and old_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and old_spy_close <= old_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            ):
                quantity = int(
                    (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot > 0:
            if current_rsi is not None and current_rsi > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
                self.aapl_lot = 0
        else:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

class TwoStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily
            ).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required = [self.spy, self.aapl]
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required):
            self._update_market_state(data)
            return

        self._update_market_state(data)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)

        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell_reason = aapl_rsi > 60

        if spy_crossed_below and self.spy_lot > 0:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if aapl_sell_reason and self.aapl_lot > 0:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        if spy_crossed_above and self.spy_lot == 0:
            shares = int(
                (float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40)
                / spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.spy_lot = shares

        if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.aapl_lot == 0:
            available_cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)
            if available_cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.aapl_lot = shares

    def _update_market_state(self, data: Slice):
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            self.spy_sma.Update(data[self.spy].EndTime, spy_close)

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                current_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
                self.previous_spy_sma = current_sma
            else:
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
                self.previous_spy_sma = None

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(data[self.aapl].EndTime, aapl_close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

class TwoSlotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily
            ).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.red_days = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required = [self.spy, self.aapl,
                    self.symbols["IBM"], self.symbols["BAC"], self.symbols["AIG"]]

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        if spy_bar is None or aapl_bar is None:
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self._update_state(spy_bar.Close, self.spy_sma.Current.Value,
                               aapl_bar.Close)
            return

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
        aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self._update_state(spy_close, spy_sma, aapl_close)
            return

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if (
            self.spy_lot > 0
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot, tag="Strategy A sell")
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot, tag="Strategy B sell"
            )
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        # Strategy A buy.
        if (
            self.spy_lot == 0
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        ):
            quantity = int(
                (0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) / spy_close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="Strategy A buy")
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        # Strategy B buy.
        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.red_days >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl, quantity, tag="Strategy B buy"
                    )
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self._update_state(spy_close, spy_sma, aapl_close)

    def _update_state(self, spy_close, spy_sma, aapl_close):
        if getattr(self, "_previous_aapl_close", None) is not None:
            if aapl_close < self._previous_aapl_close:
                self.red_days += 1
            else:
                self.red_days = 0

        self._previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
